paired_patient_rule: exactly one pre-treatment and one post-treatment processed bulk RNA-seq sample with an embedded ordinal pathological-response category
global_pc_primary_gene_universe: non-locked genes with finite values across paired samples, mean logTPM >= 1 and non-zero paired-delta standard deviation
global_pc_sensitivity_gene_universe: top 5000 non-locked genes by paired-delta variance after finite-value and non-zero-variance filtering
composition_method: MCP-counter v1.1 HUGO-symbol transcriptomic-marker mean scores
wild_bootstrap_residual_scaling: HC2 leverage adjustment from the reduced model
correction_families: six family-score variants within each scoring-method and model-spec family
five model specifications within each scoring-method and score-variant family
ten MCP-counter populations within the base response-model family
three PCs within each global or composition PC response-model family
